about_the_game:
Kotoba Dash is a fast-paced Japanese vocabulary game that blends arcade-style action with language learning. Whether you’re just starting out or looking for a fun way to review, Kotoba Dash challenges you to think quickly, recognize words, and sharpen your memory in an engaging, replayable format.

Learn Through Play

Every round tests your knowledge of Japanese words as you dash to collect the correct scroll. The faster you grab scrolls, the higher your score climbs. But choose wrong, and you’ll lose a life. Accuracy and speed work together to drive your score higher, helping you track your personal best and see your progress over time.

Features

  • Arcade-paced learning – review vocabulary while dodging mistakes and chasing high scores.

  • Multiple difficulty levels – start with beginner words and climb your way up to more advanced sets.

  • Replayable design – every run is different, making practice feel like a game, not a chore.

  • Progression system – unlock new challenges as you prove your mastery.

  • Review screens – learn from your mistakes after each run and reinforce tricky words.

  • Full vocabulary list – access a complete word list anytime for extra study outside of gameplay.

  • Built-in demo mode – try the game for free before committing to the full experience.

Who It’s For

Kotoba Dash is perfect for learners of Japanese at all levels who want a fun way to reinforce vocabulary. It’s also a great casual game for anyone who enjoys quick, skill-based challenges with a unique educational twist.

How many scrolls can you collect before mistakes cut your run short?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
